question: What is the distance of the Marathon race?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42.195 Km.**__

__
 
• The distance of the Marathon race is **42.195 Km**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Marathon** is a long-distance foot race with a distance of** 42.195 kilometres**, usually run as a road race, but the distance can be covered on trail routes. 
 
• The **Marathon** can be completed by running or with a run/walk strategy. There are also wheelchair divisions.
 
• The Marathon has been an Olympic distance since the modern Olympics started in** 1896**, but nothing like it was ever seen in the ancient Olympics, run from **776BC to 261AD.**
 
• The marathon was one of the original modern Olympic events in **1896.** The distance did not become standardized until **1921.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Singh Yadav** is an Indian marathon runner. Ram represented India at the 2012 Summer Olympics, London.
 
• **Nitendra Singh Rawat** is one of the best marathoners in India.
 
• A barefooted long-distance runner from Bihar, **Shivnath** is the greatest Indian marathon runner.
